Aquatic Quirk.name: Aquatic Quirk
Aquatic Quirk.description:
🐟 Your body is built for water: gills, fins, webbed hands and feet or slick skin, as you choose.

🌱 At the start you breathe underwater, outswim any athlete, hold a breath through smoke and gas on land, and rush through water to a target or a drowning swimmer.
📈 With training: sonar in murky water, groups towed from floods, any grip slipped, tail and body slams, boats stopped dead, breaches onto a target, rescues held underwater.
⚠️ Dry air and heat wear on you.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Overheating, as exertion out of water heats and dries your body.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Gang Orca (Orca), Tsuyu Asui (Frog).

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Quirk Mobility +10, Quirk Stamina +10, Swimming +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Slipstream Dash, Deepwater Breath
Aquatic Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: a body built for water: gills, fins, webbed hands and feet or slick skin (player's choice). New adult user: breathes underwater, swims several times faster than a human champion, dives to about thirty meters, sees in murky water and holds a breath on land for minutes. More needs techniques. Limits: ordinary pace on land; dry air and heat dry skin and gills: hours from water tire them until wet again; hot rooms exhaust them; they move through water, never move it; polluted water harms them as anyone. Quirk Strain: living in the body costs nothing; light: dash, held breath; moderate: sonar, towing, slipping a hold; heavy: body slam, ramming a vessel; severe: signature breach, whole-district rescue. Type: Mutant. Law: the features break no law, but holding a person under water is attempted murder, whatever the intent. Look: permanent: gill slits on neck or ribs, fins on forearms, back, calves or a tail, webbed digits, smooth damp skin in the player's colors.
